column1: # Kaomoji, written for this project. Columns, separated by a tab:
# A row without a kaomoji is a words row: its words apply to the rows below it,
# up to the next words row or the next group. A group's first words row may name
# the group as Traditional|Simplified. Words on a kaomoji's own row apply to it alone.
# Words follow the rule of emoji.tsv: kana or ja: in front is Japanese.
# Groups appear in the keyboard's kaomoji panel in this order, rows best first; the
# first row of each group is also offered in the candidate row after the ^_^ key.
# No right-to-left letters and no control characters; at most 24 characters.
